extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a Court of Session financial provision action in Scotland asks whether Lodestar can lend £29,000 against matrimonial property of around £290,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the detail provided. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, as our funding is directed at matters in England and Wales. It would also help to have details of the matrimonial property and any existing charges over it, the client's circumstances, your firm's costs estimate to proof, and any key procedural dates. Once we have reviewed that information we will come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
